title: Public Parks in Saharanpur for Weekend Meetups
description: A short guide to three public parks in Saharanpur that suit small, daytime weekend meetups and group walks.
summary: Saharanpur has several public green spaces where a small group can meet in daylight. This guide covers three of them and how to plan around them.

sections.heading: Company Garden
sections.body: Company Garden is a public garden in Saharanpur that suits relaxed daytime group walks. Pick a clear landmark inside the garden as your meeting point and share it with the group.

sections.heading: Ambedkar Park
sections.body: Ambedkar Park is a spacious open public park, which makes weekend morning meetups practical. Open space means a group can spread out and still stay in sight of each other.

sections.heading: Gandhi Park
sections.body: Gandhi Park is a public park in Saharanpur City. Check the current gate timings locally before you invite people, since opening hours can change.

sections.heading: Planning a safe first meetup
sections.body:
Meet in daylight, tell someone where you are going, and keep the first group small.

- Share the general venue publicly
- Agree on a time to finish
- Use the in-app report or block tools if something feels wrong

faqs.question: Are these parks free to enter?
faqs.answer: Entry rules can change, so check at the gate or with the park office before you plan a group visit.
